title: Decentralized Agent Architecture Framework
abstract: Enhanced D-Central Agent module implementation guide with Go code for the core DcentralAgent struct and all eight subsystem modules: MeshManager (BATMAN-adv/LibreMesh), IdentityService (Hyperledger Aries/DIDs), StorageManager (IPFS/Filecoin), ServiceRegistry (OCI/K3s/FluxCD), TokenModule (Gnosis Chain/EVM), AiModule (HuggingFace/OpenFL), DAOManager (EVM governance contracts), and Logging/Telemetry (Prometheus/eBPF/Grafana), with inter-module communication via an event bus.

title: D Central Security Mesh Design
abstract: Design and GitHub-ready scaffold for a standalone D-Central Security Mesh project built on Frigate (camera NVR) and Shinobi with IPFS storage and DID-based access control, including a Raspberry Pi one-line deployment script, CI workflow, and a 17-file granular documentation index covering architecture, mesh service registration, identity/DID setup, and operational runbooks.

title: Decentralized Security Network Expansion
abstract: Enhanced business plan for a Security Mesh Network (SMN) product built on D-Central's mesh technology, covering a four-layer stack (infrastructure/platform/service/application), tokenized participant incentives, PIPEDA/GDPR compliance, and expanded B2B (enterprise campuses, critical infrastructure, government/education, cannabis/mining verticals) and B2C (residential, small business, mobile) target market segments.
